name: Financial Conduct Authority
coverage: UK cryptoasset regime, authorisation, custody, market abuse, disclosures, perimeter guidance.
notes: Core UK source. Monitor publications, consultations, policy statements and cryptoassets pages.

name: Bank of England
coverage: Digital pound, systemic stablecoins, settlement assets, payment systems and financial stability.
notes: RSS page available for news, events and publications.

name: HM Treasury
coverage: UK legislative framework for cryptoassets, stablecoins and financial services policy.
notes: Use GOV.UK search/collections and policy papers for legislation and consultations.

name: European Securities and Markets Authority
coverage: MiCA, CASPs, technical standards, supervisory convergence, market abuse and disclosures.
notes: Core EU securities regulator source for MiCA implementation.

name: European Banking Authority
coverage: MiCA, ARTs, EMTs, significant tokens, prudential and supervisory matters.
notes: Core EU source for stablecoin supervision under MiCA.

name: U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission
coverage: Crypto asset securities, disclosure, registration pathways, custody and market intermediaries.
notes: Monitor the Crypto Task Force, statements, speeches, rulemaking and enforcement context.

name: Commodity Futures Trading Commission
coverage: Digital assets, commodities, derivatives, market oversight and customer protection.
notes: CFTC provides digital assets resources and RSS feeds for updates.

name: Bank for International Settlements
coverage: Tokenisation, stablecoins, CBDC, unified ledger, settlement, financial stability.
notes: High-value source for institutional tokenisation and monetary system analysis.

name: International Organization of Securities Commissions
coverage: Crypto and digital asset market integrity, custody, conflicts, market abuse and cross-border coordination.
notes: Monitor policy recommendations and implementation reviews.

name: Financial Stability Board
coverage: Global cryptoasset framework, global stablecoin arrangements and financial stability risks.
notes: Core source for global stablecoin and cross-border financial stability policy.

name: Basel Committee on Banking Supervision
coverage: Prudential treatment of banks' cryptoasset exposures, tokenised assets and stablecoins.
notes: Key source for bank capital and prudential treatment.

name: Ledger Insights
coverage: Enterprise blockchain, CBDC, stablecoins, tokenised deposits, capital markets and tokenisation.
notes: Useful market context; filter for institutional and regulatory relevance.

name: Finextra
coverage: Banking technology, digital market infrastructure, tokenisation and payments.
notes: Good for market infrastructure and banking implementation context.

name: Latham & Watkins UK Cryptoasset Regulatory Tracker
coverage: UK cryptoasset regulatory milestones, consultation papers and implementation timelines.
notes: Useful secondary source for timeline and practical interpretation.

name: Norton Rose Fulbright Regulation Tomorrow
coverage: Regulatory updates across UK, EU and global financial services, including cryptoassets and MiCA.
notes: Useful for concise summaries of regulator publications.

name: arXiv / academic research
coverage: Emerging research on stablecoins, tokenisation, market structure, taxonomy and regulatory impact.
notes: Use selectively; valuable for deeper research but not a primary regulatory source.

name: Office of the Comptroller of the Currency
coverage: National bank and federal savings association crypto-asset activities, custody, DLT, stablecoin and payment-stablecoin issuer implementation.
notes: Monitor interpretive letters, bulletins, proposed rules and GENIUS Act implementation.

name: Federal Reserve Board
coverage: Crypto-asset activities by supervised banking organizations, dollar-token activities, payments, supervision and financial stability.
notes: Monitor supervision and regulation press releases, speeches and letters.

name: Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation
coverage: FDIC-supervised institutions, stablecoin implementation, bank crypto-asset risks and deposit-insurance perimeter issues.
notes: Useful for U.S. bank stablecoin and crypto-risk supervisory developments.

name: Federal Register
coverage: U.S. proposed rules, final rules, notices and implementation documents from federal agencies.
notes: High-value source for formal rulemaking timelines and consultation windows.

name: U.S. Department of the Treasury
coverage: Digital asset policy, financial stability, international coordination, AML/CFT and stablecoin policy.
notes: Monitor press releases, reports and policy papers on digital assets and financial stability.
